The '''Altarrn system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Glythe sector/Legends|Glythe sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altarrn]].
